name: EditorialAuth

props.description: Heading level of the story title. Pass 2 when the form card owns the page h1 (`<EditorialAuthCard level>`).
props.name: level

props.description: Decorative art (aria-hidden): the picture on the front card under artFrame="cards", rendered as given under artFrame="none".
props.name: art

props.description: "cards" wraps `art` in the fixed rotated card pair; "none" renders free-form art (floating app chips, an illustration) in an unframed auto-height box (--editorial-auth-art-free-max-width / --editorial-auth-art-free-height).
props.name: artFrame

props.description: "brand" paints the story column with a DARK brand surface in every theme — --editorial-auth-brand-background, default a deep gradient of the --primary hue (lightness capped 24% → 14%, angle --editorial-auth-brand-gradient-angle) — and re-scopes --foreground / --muted-foreground / --text-brand inside it so the title, copy, kicker and benefit tick take light ink (--editorial-auth-brand-foreground, an HSL triple, default 0 0% 100%; --editorial-auth-brand-muted-foreground defaults to it). A Logo in the eyebrow shows its dark-surface artwork automatically (data-logo-scheme="dark"). Padded and rounded by --editorial-auth-brand-padding / --editorial-auth-brand-radius. Keep the pair at WCAG AA when you retint it.
props.name: appearance

props.description: "lg" is the editorial hero (2.5rem / 1.7); "md" is sign-in density (--editorial-auth-title-md-font-size 2rem / --editorial-auth-title-md-line-height 1.4). The phone band sets its own size for both.
props.name: titleSize

props.description: The description in the phone band (< 48rem). "hidden" makes the band one line — kicker/logo and title only (--editorial-auth-band-description-display). Desktop and tablet always show it.
props.name: bandDescription

props.description: A short line shown ONLY in the phone band (< 48rem), in place of the description; desktop and tablet keep `description` (--editorial-auth-band-subtitle-display / -font-size).
props.name: bandSubtitle

props.description: "card" keeps the story beside the form card inside the page gutters. "split" is a FULL-BLEED sign-in page — render it as the page root, no shell padding: the story fills its side edge to edge and top to bottom (--editorial-auth-split-track-size 1.15fr 1fr, --editorial-auth-split-min-height 100dvh) over a grid texture (--editorial-auth-split-texture-background-image; none drops it), logo at the top, title + copy + art centred, benefits pinned at the bottom in a row; the form card becomes a plain centred column (--editorial-auth-split-form-max-width 25rem). Below 48rem the story is a full-bleed band over the form. Pair with appearance="brand".
props.name: layout

related: CenteredShell — use variant="auth" for the application sign-in shell.
tagline: A sign-in / sign-up page (gh#1439): a story column (kicker, display title — line breaks kept —, copy, a decorative card pair carrying `art`, benefit lines with a check) beside the form card (`children`, default 460px). Geometry: `--editorial-auth-*`.
usage: DO keep the form in an EditorialAuthCard with Form + FormField.

Below 48rem the columns stack and the story becomes a compact band (kicker + one-line title, copy kept; art and benefits hidden). It is the kit's default as tokens (--editorial-auth-track-size, --editorial-auth-title-white-space, --editorial-auth-art-display, --editorial-auth-benefits-display …); re-declare them under your own query to keep the art.

From 48rem to 64rem (tablet) both columns stay and shrink: the card caps at 22.5rem (--editorial-auth-track-size: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 22.5rem)) and the gap drops to --space-10, so nothing overflows from 320px up.
